Name: ✦ Village Guardian
Description: <light_purple>It has protected this village since before you arrived, and it isn't stopping now.
- A <red><bold>Knockback</bold> <reset>shove with a golem's full weight behind it
- A <green><bold>Backpack</bold> <reset>row for whatever the village needs carried
- Iron <red><bold>Armor</bold> <reset>and a <red><bold>Taunt</bold> <reset>that puts it between you and the mob

Notifications.20: <light_purple>It plants its feet between you and the danger — Village Guardian takes its post.
Notifications.65: <light_purple>It has never once let anything past.
